releases.name: v1.2.0 — OpenCode 2.x support (one package, both versions)
releases.body:
## Added

- **OpenCode 2.x support** — one package now loads on both opencode 1.x and 2.x. The default export carries two entrypoints: `tui` (V1) and `setup` (V2, new plugin API). The measurement core (TPS / AVG / TTFT / thinking stream) is shared and unchanged.

## How it works on 2.x

- Events: `session.text.delta` / `session.reasoning.delta` (streaming TPS), `session.step.started` (TTFT origin), `session.step.ended` (AVG + calibration), `session.step.failed` / `session.tool.input.started` (clear live state).
- Render: `ctx.ui.slot({ append: "prompt.footer.status" })` — V1's `session_prompt_right` slot no longer exists in V2. Override with the new `slot` option if placement needs adjusting.
- Theme: V2 semantic tokens (`text.muted`, `text.feedback.*.base`, `hue.accent[500]`).
- No new dependencies: V2 API types are declared locally; nothing is imported from `@opencode/plugin` at runtime.

## Install

```bash
# opencode 1.x (unchanged)
opencode plugin @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter -g

# opencode 2.x
opencode plugin add @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter
```

On 2.x, terminal-client plugin config lives in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` under `plugins` (your `tui.json` is migrated automatically). Options are the same as before; 2.x uses the object form:

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter",
      "options": { "spinner": { "theme": "tech", "cells": 6 } }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Feedback wanted (2.x)

The V2 adapter is verified against the published 2.x type definitions but not yet against a running V2 binary. If the meter shows in an unexpected spot, set the `slot` option (e.g. `"prompt.footer"`, `"session.composer.top"`) and please open an issue with a screenshot.

opencode 1.x behavior is unchanged (tested on 1.17.20 / 1.18.30).

releases.name: v1.1.2 — fix install failure on opencode >=1.18 (ERESOLVE)
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **Plugin could not be installed on opencode >= 1.18** — `opencode plugin add @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter` failed with `unable to resolve dependency tree` (npm ERESOLVE).

## Why

Newer `@opencode-ai/plugin` pulls `@opentui/core` 0.5.x, but this package's peer range `^0.4.2` capped it below 0.5. opencode's installer uses npm's strict arborist resolver, so the tree became unresolvable. (bun only warns on peer conflicts, which is why local testing didn't catch it.)

## Change

Widen peer ranges (metadata only, no code change):

- `@opentui/core`: `^0.4.2` → `>=0.4.2 <1`
- `@opentui/solid`: `^0.4.2` → `>=0.4.2 <1`

## Reinstall

```bash
opencode plugin @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter -g -f
```

If it still fails with `unable to resolve dependency tree` right after this release, your local npm cache (~/.npm) still holds the pre-1.1.2 metadata. Refresh it once:

```bash
npm cache clean --force
```

releases.name: v1.1.1 — Switch to Trusted Publishing
releases.body: Pipeline change only. Switch from NPM_TOKEN to npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC). No code changes.

releases.name: v1.1.0 — maintenance & security
releases.body:
- Security: override brace-expansion ^5.0.8 (DoS vuln)
- Docs: npm/license/stars badges now clickable
- Bundles all v1.0.x fixes: npm dual solid-js instance (v1.0.1), idle blank-space reservation (v1.0.2)
- Released via GitHub Release → auto-publish flow

Fix: single text node for the thinking particle stream — no blank space reserved when idle (multiple empty cells reserved width). Also fixes the npm dual solid-js instance issue from v1.0.0 (reactive <Show> replaced with imperative updates).
